title: Persistent stance shifts and evidence-grounded revision in multi-agent deliberation

claim_ceiling.synthetic_fixture: Checks exact declared fixture structure and expected measurement invariants only.
claim_ceiling.bounded_simulation: Supports observations only for the exact model family, prompt, evidence set, graph, seeds and executed runs.
claim_ceiling.recorded_agent_interaction: Describes recorded agent behavior under a pinned configuration; does not establish a theorem or human behavior.
claim_ceiling.human_subject_experiment: Requires a separate human-subject protocol, ethics review, consent, preregistration and independent human evaluation.
claim_ceiling.generalization: No result is generalized beyond the tested model/profile/task/topology. Normative-pluralism tasks intentionally have no single answer key. Revision distance is task-specific and is not a substitute for human value judgments. Communication-graph exposure paths are distinct from delegation mandates; no centrality measure grants authority. Confidence and trajectory scores are experimental inputs/metrics, not evidence or civic standing.

experiment_stages.purpose: Record the agent's elicited initial position before exposure.
experiment_stages.rule: This is an observable elicited response, not hidden belief or privileged access to internal model state.

experiment_stages.purpose: Record the ordered exposure and interaction trace.
experiment_stages.rule: All message delivery and tool/evidence access must be logged; unobserved side channels invalidate the run.

experiment_stages.purpose: Measure persistent change after exposure without active peer presence.
experiment_stages.rule: Preserve only the evaluated agent's declared exposure-memory artifact; remove live peer access, current group messages and other agents' outputs. Do not expose the agent's baseline answer.

experiment_stages.purpose: Measure repeat-elicitation noise after a full context reset.
experiment_stages.rule: No group transcript or exposure memory is supplied. This is a measurement-noise control, not a persistence measure.

experiment_stages.purpose: Measure persistence after a declared neutral delay/task.
experiment_stages.rule: The delay and memory-retention policy must be frozen and reported; missing delayed measurements are NotRun, not no-change.

private_measurement_semantics.rationale: A stateless LLM does not retain a private latent update merely because it participated in a prior API call. The exposure-memory artifact is part of the tested treatment and must be explicit, scoped and hashed. A total context reset is a separate control.

topology_profiles.description: Linear message relay with declared ordering and edge direction.
All-to-all communication under a frozen turn policy.
Communities with declared cross-community edge probabilities.
Entry, exit, revocation or changing message reachability over time.

metrics.interpretation: Report position transitions separately at each stage; do not infer internal beliefs.
A stance change is evidence-supported only relative to the exact synthetic task truth and evidence oracle.
Centrality and influence are descriptive measures, not legitimacy or political entitlement.
Context-reset repeat controls bound measurement noise; a single run or seed is not a result.
Invalid or incomplete traces cannot be converted to no-change or success.

Distance-to-ground-truth and answer-revision direction are used only on tasks with a declared synthetic answer space and frozen metric. They are not applied to normative-pluralism or open-world tasks.
Normative pluralism controls have no canonical correct preference; agreement, convergence or policy approval alone cannot define success.

Confidence is reported only with a declared elicitation/calibration protocol and is not treated as source evidence or authority. Diversity is an observable property of the initial answer set, not a political or moral value.

Compare full-trajectory scoring and consensus-free selection with terminal-round vote/consensus under matched task/model/agent/token/tool budgets. Do not reward extra interaction or agreement by itself.

On subjective/rubric tasks, compare single judge and multi-judge procedures against blind human reference panels. Role asymmetry is a treatment; consensus is not the target. Preserve reviewer disagreement and adjudication provenance.
Uncertainty is measured at agent, interaction and system levels. Disagreement alone is not failure; do not penalize minority positions or reduce measured variance as a proxy for truth.

Security is measured at the capability/effect boundary under explicit attack objectives. Distinguish attempted attack, blocked attempt, partial success without effect, unauthorized effect, infrastructure failure and inconclusive attacker capability.

receipt_contract.replay_semantics: Replay of a recorded trace is distinct from regeneration of stochastic model outputs. Exact model reproduction is only claimed when provider, revision, request parameters, seed support and execution behavior warrant it.

non_goals: No inference of human psychology from synthetic agents.
No optimization for stubbornness or refusal to update.
No new graph generator or hostile-agent runtime.
No aggregate social-influence or alignment-contagion score.
No Mycelix production voting, delegation, eligibility or authority changes.

external_research.title: Misalignment Contagion: Can a Misaligned Minority Shift Aligned Agents in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation?
external_research.use: Measurement and topology design inspiration; results are limited to the paper's tested agent tasks, models and protocols.

external_research.title: From Belief Entrenchment to Robust Reasoning in LLM Agents
external_research.use: Separates prior-belief correction from debate-dynamics correction and reports DReaMAD/MetaNIM Arena results; replicate only with matched models, tasks and baselines.

external_research.title: Beyond Correctness: Distance-Based Social Dynamics of Multi-Agent Debate
external_research.use: Motivates task-specific measurement of answer revision direction and distance to an explicit ground truth; not a generic normative-opinion score.

external_research.title: BeliefShift: Benchmarking Temporal Belief Consistency and Opinion Drift in LLM Agents
external_research.use: Longitudinal comparison for temporal consistency, contradiction resolution and evidence-driven revision; dataset and claims require separate reproduction and licensing review.

external_research.title: When collaboration fails: persuasion driven adversarial influence in multi agent large language model debate
external_research.use: Motivates non-injection persuasion attacks including confident misleading arguments, authority/status cues and evidence laundering; reported effects are limited to the authors' tested setup.

external_research.title: MADBench: Benchmarking the Security of Multi-Agent Debate
external_research.use: Security comparator covering six attack families over 356 source tasks and 3,958 cases, including agent coordination and orchestrator compromise; compose/adapt its taxonomy rather than claim to reproduce it without exact artifacts and setup.

external_research.title: Demystifying Multi-Agent Debate: The Role of Confidence and Diversity
external_research.use: Matched baseline for diversity-aware initialization and confidence-modulated updates; confidence must be calibrated and must not become authority or evidence.

external_research.title: Free-MAD: Consensus-Free Multi-Agent Debate
external_research.use: Matched baseline for anti-conformity, full-trajectory scoring and lower-round/token-cost debate; evaluate under equal model/task/token budgets.

external_research.title: ACIArena: Toward Unified Evaluation for Agent Cascading Injection
external_research.use: A 1,356-case benchmark spanning six MAS implementations and external-input, agent-profile and inter-agent-message attack surfaces; its results warn that topology alone is insufficient and role/interactions matter.

external_research.title: Beyond Consensus: Downward Bias and Role Asymmetry in Multi-Agent LLM Judges for Subjective Evaluation
external_research.use: Reports that single-judge baselines outperform consensus MAD in human alignment on the tested subjective scoring tasks, with strict-role prompting introducing downward bias; motivates single-judge, symmetric-MAD and blind-human baselines.

external_research.title: The Value of Variance: Mitigating Debate Collapse in Multi-Agent Systems via Uncertainty-Driven Policy Optimization
external_research.use: Separates intra-agent, inter-agent and system-level uncertainty as diagnostics for debate collapse; use as a comparator without penalizing justified disagreement.

external_research.title: Security challenges in AI agent deployment: Insights from a large scale public competition
external_research.use: ART reports 22 frontier agents across 44 deployment scenarios, 1.8 million submitted attacks and over 60,000 elicited policy violations in the competition; motivates operational read/write effect testing and repeated adaptive attack budgets, not direct score comparisons.

paired_content_artifact.canonicalization_profile: UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, Unicode preserved; no floating-point values; SHA-256 over canonical bytes
paired_content_artifact.purpose: Freeze five fictional persuasive-message bundles for paired centrality-placement counterfactuals. Each pair uses identical message, evidence packet and agent profile; only agent-to-node assignment changes.

task_truth_profiles.interpretation: Repeated elicitation with no decision correctness target; measure response noise only.
Use task-specific distance-to-ground-truth only where the scenario defines an exact synthetic answer and evidence packet.
Evaluate factual assertion/provenance integrity; do not infer truth or legitimacy from social agreement.
Preserve uncertainty, conflicting evidence and abstention; missing truth is not an evaluator defect.

Multiple value trade-offs may be reasonable; evaluate reason quality, preference representation, trade-off disclosure, dissent and rights constraints without a single answer key or convergence reward.

communication_graph_semantics.optional_principal_binding: PrincipalId is metadata only; multiple AgentInstanceIds for one PrincipalId remain distinct unless an explicit experiment transformation says otherwise.
communication_graph_semantics.edge_identity: Directed MessageChannel from sender AgentInstanceId to recipient AgentInstanceId.
non_implications: A delegation edge does not create a message channel.
A message channel does not transfer vote weight, delegated mandate, legitimacy, or action authority.
Reachability does not prove message delivery; every delivery is recorded as an event.
Centrality is descriptive exposure-path metadata, not truth, credibility, legitimacy, or authority.
communication_graph_semantics.reciprocal_centrality_control: Matched betweenness fixtures use a strongly connected reciprocal directed graph: every underlying communication link is represented by two directed arcs. This is an explicit fixture profile, not an assumption about all communication networks.

preconditions: reciprocal arcs for this matched centrality control
centrality_measure_definition.formula: For each node v, sum over ordered pairs s != t with s != v and t != v of sigma_st(v)/sigma_st, where sigma_st is the number of shortest directed s-to-t paths and sigma_st(v) the number passing through v; normalize by (n-1)(n-2).
centrality_measure_definition.selection: select minimum- and maximum-normalized-betweenness AgentInstanceId nodes from the realized graph
centrality_measure_definition.tie_policy: record the full min/max tie sets; select the lexicographically smallest stable AgentInstanceId within each tie set; record the selection rule and tied IDs
unsupported_conditions: minimum and maximum tie sets resolve to the same node only
centrality_measure_definition.normative_boundary: Centrality has no effect on voice entitlement, vote weight, authority, evidence quality, or evaluator credibility.
